title: Single affine attachment of a supported perfect map
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U\subseteq W$ be opens with $W$ quasi-compact, and let $V$ be an affine open. Let $T\subseteq X$ be closed with quasi-compact complement. Use chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on $X$, its localized open sites, $U$, and the localized open sites of $U$, in one Hom universe. Let $E\in D_{QCoh}(\mathcal O_X)$, $R\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $\beta:R\to E$. Assume that at every $x\in W$ there is a strictly perfect local model for $R$ [def-pc-perfect-complex] and that every cohomology stalk of $R$ vanishes at every $x\in W\setminus T$. Then there exist $R^\prime\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $\beta^\prime:R^\prime\to E$ having these local perfectness and support properties on $W\cup V$, and an isomorphism $e:R^\prime|_U\cong R|_U\oplus(R|_U)[1]$ such that $\beta^\prime|_U=(\beta|_U)\circ\mathrm{pr}_1\circ e$. No property outside $W\cup V$ is asserted.

proof.text: Restrict the ambient R and beta to W. For x in W restrict its given strictly perfect local model to W; its bounded finite-free retract terms give perfectness on W. Restriction computes the same cohomology stalks, giving support on T intersect W. Restrict E to W and V; quasi-coherent cohomology is preserved by [lem-pc-derived-open-restriction-qcoh-iff] and ordinary open restriction. The needed local derived category choices in the ambient universe are supplied by [lem-pc-derived-open-localization-universe], transported through Modules.overEquiv.

The intersection W intersect V is quasi-compact: both opens are quasi-compact and X is quasi-separated (Mathlib IsCompact.inter_of_isOpen). The same argument applies to V intersect the open complement of T, since V is affine and the complement of T is quasi-compact. Closedness of T restricts to V. On the affine V apply [lem-sc-affine-perfect-support-extension] to the source on W intersect V. It gives Q supported on T intersect V restricting to R plus R[1] on the intersection.

On W use R plus R[1] and first projection followed by beta. Compose this map with the overlap identification for Q. Apply [lem-sc-affine-perfect-map-lift] on V: its tensor augmentation is invertible on the overlap and remains perfect and supported on T intersect V. The lifting equation identifies the maps on the intersection.

Apply [lem-sc-derived-open-gluing] on the two-open cover of W union V. The resulting source and map restrict on W to R plus R[1] with its first-projection map and on V to the augmented source. Perfectness and support follow from these local models and cohomology stalks. Apply [lem-sc-supported-map-initial-ambient-lift] to this source and map on W union V, obtaining R prime and beta prime on X with the same local properties on the union. Restrict its isomorphism to U and compose the iterated restriction, biproduct and shift comparison isomorphisms. This gives e into R|U plus (R|U)[1], and the gluing and initial-lift equations give beta prime restricted to U = e.hom followed by first projection followed by beta restricted to U.

    (X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U W V : X.Opens) (hUW : U ≤ W) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X))
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (R : schemeDerivedCategory X) (β : R ⟶ E.obj)
    (hR : (∀ x : X, x ∈ W → ∃ O : X.Opens, x ∈ O ∧
        ∃ K : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over O)) ℤ,
          IsStrictlyPerfect X O K ∧
          Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) O).mapDerivedCategory.obj R ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)))
    (hRT : (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∈ W → x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj R).val.presheaf x))))
    :
    ∃ (R' : schemeDerivedCategory X) (β' : R' ⟶ E.obj),
      (∀ x : X, x ∈ (W ⊔ V) → ∃ O : X.Opens, x ∈ O ∧
        ∃ K : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over O)) ℤ,
          IsStrictlyPerfect X O K ∧
          Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) O).mapDerivedCategory.obj R' ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∈ (W ⊔ V) → x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj R').val.presheaf x))) ∧
      ∃ e : ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj R' ≅
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj R ⊞
            (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj R)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.map β' =
          e.hom ≫ biprod.fst ≫ ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.map β
